The long tapering white palm crease attracts attention without being essential to recognizing the gesture.
Only the large original was inspected. Actual 32–64px legibility is unverified.

reason: The gesture reads clearly and has a usable human character, but clipped pointed junctions and a decorative palm crease need one controlled refinement. Genericness remains an open issue, not assumed solved.
